description: This file contains utility functions for handling generated output files, including writing output content based on change detection and reporting via CLI. It utilizes Node.js modules for path handling and URL conversions and references shared and bundled utility modules.

methods.name: writeGeneratedOutput
methods.description: Writes the output file if it has changed, based on provided parameters, and returns an object indicating whether a change occurred, whether the file was written, and the output path.

methods.name: reportGeneratedOutputCli
methods.description: Reports status of generated output via CLI, checking if the output is stale or has been updated, and adjusts process exit code or logs messages accordingly.
